pages.text: The core machine of Chishi tech: burning Chishi materials generates Chi Energy, which purifies Raw Chishi Blocks into Chishi Essence.
Crafting the purifier requires a Red Machine Component, a Furnace, a Blast Furnace, Gold Ingots and Raw Chishi Blocks.

$(bold)Fuel:$(br)$(li)Chishi Crystal$(li)Raw Chishi Block$(br)$(bold)Purifying:$(br)Draws 5 Chi Energy per tick to turn Raw Chishi Blocks into Chishi Essence.$(br)Connect it to an Energy Cell via pipes so it never runs dry.
